title: Guidance Note on the Processing of Personal Information of Voters, and the Countering of Misinformation and Disinformation during Elections
summary: A guidance note issued by the Information Regulator on 14 May 2024 explaining how POPIA applies to political parties and independent candidates, including consent for direct marketing and automated calling during campaigns. It addresses misinformation and disinformation enabled by digital platforms, and states that using a person's voice or image without consent to spread fake messages, particularly with generative AI, violates their right to privacy. It is the Regulator's only published guidance found that mentions AI; no guidance specifically on AI or automated decision-making under section 71 was found.
key_obligations: Parties must obtain voter consent before campaign messages by phone, SMS or email
Automated campaign calls must offer voters an opt-out
